milan-ligurian-apennines-and-portofino.slogan: A 304 km loop out of Pavia

sections.advice: This Passo del Penice → Bobbio Trebbia road stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

sections.advice: Bobbio Trebbia road → Portofino coast is the reward section in Milan and Northern Italy. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

scenicChapters.title: Bobbio Trebbia road → Portofino coast
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 80 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
